title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Polished Brass | Allied Brass

description:
Upgrade bathroom towel storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. This straight-bar design is part of the Que New collection, created to coordinate with matching versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- , including statement colors
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and installation hardware

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 inches

- Overall size: 33 inches W x 3 inches H x 3 inches projection
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
